capabilities: display the active note title and vault name on Discord
show elapsed session time in the presence status
apply themes and icons to the presence display
extras: Starting with v1.3.0 the plugin uses theme images hosted in its repository instead of Discord's asset system; older versions are unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show your note-taking activity as a Discord Rich Presence status.

relations.evidence: showcase your notes, vault, and current activity directly on your Discord profile

summary: Discord Rich Presence plugin that shows your active note, vault name, session time and themed icons on your Discord profile.
